items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: I remember everybody on this picture, but this little guy thought for them. But these two fellas, I just remember their names.

ctx.x: I remember the school you're speaking about.
And this Mrs. Martin, he even 20 years ago.

This fella here, I don't remember him at all. I remember everybody on this picture, but this little guy thought for them. But these two fellas, I just remember their names. It was hard for me to remember. I was such a young kid when all this was going on.
